event_id.description: TRANSPORT_ONLY: Producer delivery id; inbox event key when quarantined

occurred_at.description: created_at of a new row: UTC ISO-8601; not in the future

source_version.description: ingest.key_map.source_version: Monotonic per external_key; lower = STALE_VERSION

external_key.description: ingest.key_map.external_key: Source business key; translated to a native id

candidate_key.description: job_application.candidate_profile_id: Translated via key_map; else UNKNOWN_PARENT

job_key.description: job_application.job_requirement_id: Translated via key_map; else UNKNOWN_PARENT

organisation_key.description: TENANT_GUARD: Must equal the job's organisation; else CROSS_ACCOUNT

applied_at.description: job_application.applied_at: Not before the job was created; not in the future

source_channel.description: TRANSPORT_ONLY: No native column (MGAP-01); kept in the source file only
